parsed.post: New personal best! 0.971894 achieved by keeping DEPTH 8 and MATRIX_LR 0.03. The low learning rate continues to drive better convergence for this depth within the budget. Next: testing ASPECT_RATIO 64 to see if increasing width helps the deeper, low-LR model.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 while maintaining the successful DEPTH 8 and low MATRIX_LR 0.03 configuration to probe if increased width improves performance.
